anomalies.description: A sustained dust plume erupts from the left side of a building on a hillside, indicating a powerful explosion or structural collapse occurring over multiple seconds. The plume grows and rises continuously across all frames, with debris visible near the structure.

A sustained dust plume erupts from the left side of a building on a hillside, indicating a powerful explosion or structural collapse occurring over several seconds. The plume rises and expands continuously across all frames, with debris visible near the structure's left wall.

A sustained plume of dust and debris rises from the left side of the building, indicating a recent explosion or structural collapse; the dust cloud persists and slowly dissipates over the 7.5-second interval without new impulses, suggesting a single explosive event followed by settling debris.
A sudden, violent detonation occurs at the building, producing a bright flash, rapidly expanding fireball, and massive ejection of debris and dust cloud, characteristic of a high-energy explosion.

A sudden, violent explosion originates at the building, producing a bright flash, rapidly expanding fireball, and massive dust/debris cloud that engulfs the structure and surrounding area over several seconds.

A large-scale structural collapse with massive dust and debris cloud erupting from a building, consistent with a controlled demolition or explosive event; the cloud expands rapidly and engulfs the structure over ~7.5 seconds.

A large, sustained dust/debris cloud erupts and expands around a building on a hillside, consistent with a powerful explosion or structural collapse triggered by an explosion. The cloud originates from the base and sides of the structure and grows progressively denser and wider over time, obscuring the building.

A building undergoes progressive structural collapse, initiated by a sudden violent event (explosion or detonation), producing a rapidly expanding cloud of dust and debris that engulfs the structure over ~7.5 seconds.
